questions.prompt: The Reign of Terror occurred during which revolution?
questions.fact: Its chief architect was executed by the same method he had used on others, within a year of taking power.

questions.prompt: Which mineral is measured as 10 on the Mohs scale?
questions.fact: The scale is ordinal, not proportional: the gap between 9 and 10 is far larger than between 1 and 9.

questions.prompt: Which sport features a position called the hooker?
questions.fact: The name describes the job: hooking the ball backwards with the foot once the scrum engages.

questions.prompt: Which 2001 French film follows a shy Montmartre waitress who secretly changes lives?
questions.fact: Its colour grading pushed greens and reds heavily, a look widely imitated for years afterwards.

questions.prompt: Which country is the world's largest producer of natural rubber?
questions.fact: The trees are native to the Amazon, and were smuggled to Asia in the 1870s in a single shipment of seeds.

questions.prompt: Which novel is subtitled A Story of the Great Fire of London?
questions.fact: Samuel Pepys's diary remains the most cited eyewitness source, including his burying of cheese to save it.

questions.prompt: Which term describes making software work in another language and region?
questions.fact: The hardest parts are usually dates, plurals and text direction rather than the words themselves.
